subtitle: Sheet layout, fully offline
promotional_text: An on-device teacher for marking a sheet, setting four columns, and keeping a private press log.
description: Cropmark is a complete offline teacher for laying out a printed sheet. Finish onboarding, follow Walk to mark the four edges of the page, run Four Columns to raise four columns of type, choose a Range for the press run, and save a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your run length and journal stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Cropmark is a fully offline sheet-layout teacher and private press log. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four margin steps, start Four Columns, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
